reason_for_fresh_thesis: The immutable FAS-R1 thesis remains valid evidence of model improvement but is not compatible with the unified terminal text contract because it contains a verbal numeric surface.
execution_rules: Each fragment receives only its compiled context and already accepted predecessor fragments.
Each fragment uses one visible analysis call followed by one strict contract-submission call.
A failed fragment preserves captures and ends that attempt; a justified continuation uses a new authority and new identities.
The Harness validates and aggregates authority but does not write thesis, mechanism, counterargument or What-Would-Change content.
The terminal Judgment must pass L1 and independent content assessment before dynamic Agentic Research begins.
known_boundary: This decision authorizes one fixed-Pack value_capture Judgment only. It is a model-analysis isolation test, not Agentic Research, a five-cell report, S3 acceptance or release.
